name: dev-commands
description: bun install (devDeps: pi-coding-agent, typebox, toon, diff, typescript; no runtime deps). bun run dev (launcher from source, dev mode). bun run typecheck (tsc --noEmit; excludes *.test.ts/invoke.ts). bun run test (find .pi -name '*.test.ts' | xargs -I{} bun test ./{} — bun skips dot-dirs). bun run build (launcher binary → dist/). bun run build:release (launcher+pi binary+data.tar.gz).

name: backend-tools
description: linehash: anchored reads, edit safety, diff output, fuzzy matching, symbol edit, patch-apply (anchored hunk headers). rg: text/regex search (JSONL output for streaming). fd: file discovery (null-delimited for streaming). eza: enriched directory listing (--color --icons --oneline). ast-grep: syntax-aware search. delta: diff enrichment (--no-gitconfig for clean output). bat: syntax-highlighted display (--line-range). tru/toon_rust: TOON encode/decode in Nu layer.

name: extension-architecture
description: Extension groups: basic-tools (read/edit/write/grep/find/ls/shell/ast_search/revert_file/remove-bash), extra-tools (ast_search/scratchpad/repo_map/session/outline/effort/model), context (ctx_record/ctx_packet/ctx_inject), grove (seeds/mulch/trellis/canopy ops), passive-ui (basic-tool-grouping/thinking-steps). Vendored: pi-file-reference, recap, command-history, tool-execution-patch. Symlinks: .pi/extensions/<name> → ../../vendor/<name>/extensions.
